nffda40662a.headline: "We cannot stop, it is a lie": Mbadi explains why Kenya can't stop taking loans
nffda40662a.summary: Treasury CS John Mbadi ruled out ending public borrowing and said Kenya must balance debt servicing with service delivery. His remarks respond to criticism of the country's loans.
nffda40662a.why: Kenya's public debt levels and borrowing plans affect its sovereign credit ratings, Eurobond yields and the shilling.

n11c279fbb4.headline: Jeanswest Collapse Marks Another Blow To Australian Fashion Industry As Costs Rise
n11c279fbb4.summary: Jeanswest has collapsed, with administrators hoping to keep the brand running online. Most of the workers are in stores that will close, and the collapse adds to pressure on Australian fashion retailers as costs rise.
n11c279fbb4.why: Jeanswest is an Australian apparel retailer, and store closures and administration in the sector reflect pressure from rents, wages and consumer demand.

n2a6bb8917f.headline: Live: UK growth forecast halved to 1, Rachel Reeves says
n2a6bb8917f.summary: The Chancellor cut the UK growth forecast to 1%, blaming increased global uncertainty. The watchdog warned she would have missed her goal of balancing the books without action.
n2a6bb8917f.why: The UK growth forecast and the Chancellor's fiscal targets shape gilt yields, sterling and the outlook for UK companies. Forecasts from the Office for Budget Responsibility are closely watched by investors.

n56ceb01757.headline: New tax on tech to help Maryland budget deficit?
n56ceb01757.summary: Governor Wes Moore and General Assembly leaders announced a 3% tech tax on small businesses. It would directly affect IT companies as lawmakers address a deficit of more than $3 billion.
n56ceb01757.why: State tax policy affects technology firms and small businesses operating in Maryland. Budget deficits can lead to further tax and spending changes.

nbe3f93e573.headline: Uganda's February coffee exports jump 28% y/y on high prices
nbe3f93e573.summary: The volume of Uganda's coffee exports rose 27.9% in February from a year earlier, as high prices prompted traders to release larger stocks from inventories.
nbe3f93e573.why: Coffee is a major agricultural export for Uganda, and global coffee prices directly affect export earnings and farm incomes in producing countries.

impacts.name: Coffee
impacts.why: High coffee prices encouraged traders to release more inventory into export markets.

nd54148e8c3.headline: Annual house price growth accelerates but rental prices slow – ONS data
nd54148e8c3.summary: ONS data show annual house price growth accelerated while rental price growth slowed, released as CPI inflation slowed by more than expected.
nd54148e8c3.why: The Office for National Statistics publishes official UK inflation and housing data, which feed into Bank of England interest rate decisions and the mortgage market.

nad1f35a6c5.headline: Canadian alcohol taxes are increasing April 1. Beer producers say now isn’t a good time
nad1f35a6c5.summary: Federal alcohol taxes in Canada are set to rise 2% next month, costing taxpayers about $40 million in 2025-26 according to Beer Canada estimates, which say now is a poor time.
nad1f35a6c5.why: Federal excise duties on alcohol affect the cost structure and pricing of brewers and spirits producers selling in Canada.

n23e1887b4d.headline: ‘My concern is the small man’
n23e1887b4d.summary: Prime Minister Stuart Young says his main concern about the foreign exchange issue is its impact on ordinary citizens. He hosted a meeting with the Central Bank.
n23e1887b4d.why: Foreign exchange availability determines whether importers and businesses can access hard currency. Central bank actions on FX shape inflation and the cost of imported goods.

n1e97049c41.headline: Egypt expects to sign agreement on EU financing later in year
n1e97049c41.summary: Egypt is expected to sign a memorandum of understanding with the European Union on previously agreed financing worth 4 billion euros in the second half of the year, according to Planning Minister Rania.
n1e97049c41.why: EU financing support helps Egypt meet external funding needs and supports its currency and reserves. It is a key part of Egypt's relations with international lenders.

nc64aee9785.headline: Boosting Africa-Caribbean connectivity
nc64aee9785.summary: The African Export-Import Bank is willing to finance Nigerian energy company Oando's lease of the Guaracara refinery in Trinidad and Tobago, its acting chief operating officer said.
nc64aee9785.why: Afreximbank is a multilateral lender focused on African trade, and refinery leases affect Caribbean fuel supply and investment flows.

nc019cb5cfa.headline: Money News with Deb Knight - 26th March
nc019cb5cfa.summary: Commentary on the Budget focused on government tax cuts, with little for small business, while inflation came in lower than expected and within the RBA target range.
nc019cb5cfa.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the cash rate, and inflation data drive expectations for Australian interest rates.

nf49b801485.headline: Oil prices steady as US sanctions and inventory drop provide support
nf49b801485.summary: Oil prices were steady as US sanctions and an inventory drop bolstered support amid geopolitical tensions and supply concerns. The report does not give price levels.
nf49b801485.why: Brent crude is the global benchmark for oil, and sanctions and inventory changes directly shape its supply expectations.

n31f90a3b8d.headline: Chancellor set for a fall amid an ‘awful April’ which ‘risks kick-starting inflation again’
n31f90a3b8d.summary: Rising council tax and energy bills in April risk reigniting inflation and will significantly affect businesses, according to a London business news report.
n31f90a3b8d.why: The UK Chancellor of the Exchequer sets fiscal and tax policy, and inflation trends shape Bank of England interest-rate decisions and gilt yields.

n516423a6f4.headline: Mawson Infrastructure Group Inc. Executes New Customer Agreement with Canaan Inc., Growing and Expanding Digital Colocation Business with Latest-Gen ASICs
n516423a6f4.summary: Mawson Infrastructure Group has executed a new customer agreement with Canaan Inc., expanding its digital colocation business with latest-generation ASICs. The announcement is dated March 26, 2025.
n516423a6f4.why: Mawson operates digital infrastructure and colocation facilities for crypto mining and AI computing, so contract wins shape its revenue outlook.

nb77a333f61.headline: Mexico’s Refinery Dream Falters as Pemex Struggles
nb77a333f61.summary: Pemex, Mexico's state oil company, processed 898,153 barrels of crude daily in February, reaching just 45% of refinery capacity. The company's new Olmeca refinery is part of the project described in the report.
nb77a333f61.why: Pemex is Mexico's state-owned oil giant and one of the world's largest oil producers by volume. Its refining throughput affects Mexican fuel supply and the country's oil import needs.

n4898c07460.headline: Looking to April 2 with trepidation
n4898c07460.summary: Global stocks extended a relief rally into Wednesday in Asia, but with dwindling conviction, according to a market preview. The outlook for European and global markets is cautious ahead of April 2.
n4898c07460.why: Global equity sentiment reflects expectations for growth, policy and trade, and shapes flows across major stock indexes.

n39845cafb6.headline: Customs waive import duty on pharmaceutical raw materials
n39845cafb6.summary: The Nigeria Customs Service has waived import duty and value added tax on critical raw materials essential for pharmaceutical production. The waiver applies for a set period.
n39845cafb6.why: Import duty waivers lower input costs for drug manufacturers and affect the economics of local pharmaceutical production in Nigeria.

n1e688a099c.headline: Tariff Threats Push Mexico and Europe Closer in Trade
n1e688a099c.summary: The Netherlands' ambassador to Mexico says trade relations are shifting as US tariff threats loom, with Mexico and the European Union moving closer together.
n1e688a099c.why: Trade realignment between Mexico and the EU affects export channels and supply chains as companies respond to US tariff risk.

n8bb6f6a375.headline: Rupee rises 3 paise to close  at 85.69 against US dollar
n8bb6f6a375.summary: The rupee pared early losses and closed 3 paise higher at 85.69 against the US dollar on Wednesday, supported by a resurgence of foreign fund inflows.
n8bb6f6a375.why: The rupee's level against the dollar affects India's import costs, inflation and the returns of foreign investors in Indian assets.

n49611c88d6.headline: Rupee jumps 3 paise to close at 85.69 against US dollar
n49611c88d6.summary: The Indian rupee gained 3 paise to close at 85.69 against the US dollar. The move was supported by increased foreign fund inflows.
n49611c88d6.why: The rupee's exchange rate affects the dollar cost of India's oil and other imports, and the returns foreign investors earn on Indian assets.

impacts.name: Indian rupee
impacts.why: The rupee closed stronger against the dollar, supported by foreign fund inflows.

n979f9eb55d.headline: Coalition promises to halve fuel excise, shaving 25c off a litre of petrol
n979f9eb55d.summary: Opposition Leader Peter Dutton will promise to halve the fuel tax for 12 months in his budget reply on Thursday. The Coalition says this would reduce inflationary pressures.
n979f9eb55d.why: Fuel excise is a federal tax on petrol and diesel, so changes to it feed directly into pump prices, household costs and inflation.

n77081644a2.headline: Stock markets snap 7-day rally; Sensex drops 728 pts on profit-taking in IT, banking shares
n77081644a2.summary: Benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty snapped a seven-day winning run and closed down nearly 1 per cent on Wednesday. The 30-share BSE Sensex fell 728.69 points on profit-taking in banking and IT shares.
n77081644a2.why: The BSE Sensex tracks 30 large companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange and is the main gauge of Indian equity performance.

impacts.name: BSE Sensex
impacts.why: The index closed down 728.69 points, ending a seven-day winning streak.

n77081644a2.why_moved: Profit-taking in banking and IT shares ended a seven-day winning run for the benchmark indices, according to the report.

ne7502f3832.headline: Young people are suffering - Senate orders probe of rising cost of data
ne7502f3832.summary: Nigeria's Senate ordered a probe into the rising cost of data and asked the government to engage telecom providers on recent price increases. It also called for fair and affordable pricing.
ne7502f3832.why: Mobile data pricing affects telecom operators' revenues and household costs, and regulatory scrutiny can lead to pricing changes in Nigeria's large telecom market.

n6b0071489c.headline: ‘Sterling fell by around 0.4%’ following the lower than expected inflation reading
n6b0071489c.summary: Sterling fell by around 0.4% following a lower-than-expected inflation reading. The article points to potential market impacts from the data.
n6b0071489c.why: Sterling is the UK pound, and its moves against the dollar and euro reflect expectations for UK interest rates and the economy.
n6b0071489c.why_moved: Sterling fell after UK inflation came in below expectations, which can raise expectations of Bank of England rate cuts and weigh on the currency.

n9c1b21b62b.headline: US real estate firm CoStar sweetens bid for Australia's Domain to $1.8 billion
n9c1b21b62b.summary: US property data group CoStar raised its acquisition bid for Domain Holdings, Australia's second-largest real estate classifieds company. The revised deal is now valued at A$2.80.
n9c1b21b62b.why: Domain operates property listing websites in Australia, so its takeover price reflects the value of the country's online real estate advertising market. CoStar is a major US commercial real estate information and marketplace company.

n6b36759c83.headline: Niti Aayog working on to improve Indias penetration into global value chains for MSMEs growth
n6b36759c83.summary: India's policy think tank NITI Aayog is working to improve the country's penetration into global value chains for micro, small and medium enterprises. The effort aims to support MSME growth.
n6b36759c83.why: NITI Aayog is the Indian government's policy think tank, and MSMEs are a large share of India's employment and exports. Their integration into global supply chains shapes trade and industrial growth.

nb7742c9e3f.headline: Yen down amid cautious BoJ and US tariff risks
nb7742c9e3f.summary: The yen has been trending lower on cautious Bank of Japan policies and US tariff risks. The article examines the economic implications of the yen's decline.
nb7742c9e3f.why: The yen is a major currency whose moves affect Japanese exporters, import costs and global carry-trade positioning.

nb29ab34508.headline: Consumer confidence in the UK economy falls
nb29ab34508.summary: A recent survey shows UK consumer confidence in the economy has fallen. Some 58% of respondents believe the economy is worsening.
nb29ab34508.why: Consumer confidence signals household spending intentions, which drive a large share of UK economic activity. Weak sentiment can weigh on retail, housing and consumer-facing company earnings.

n88fcce6eb4.headline: Ringgit ends higher against US dollar despite global uncertainties
n88fcce6eb4.summary: The ringgit closed higher against the US dollar on the day, despite greater uncertainties from abroad. The move was reported from Kuala Lumpur.
n88fcce6eb4.why: The ringgit is Malaysia's currency, and its moves against the dollar affect the cost of imports and foreign investment returns in Malaysia.

n7b10159fc5.headline: Coalition pours petrol on the cost of living debate ahead of the election
n7b10159fc5.summary: The Opposition leader will deliver his reply to the treasurer's fourth budget as pressure mounts for a major economic policy ahead of the election. Cost of living is the central political debate.
n7b10159fc5.why: Budget and cost-of-living policy shape Australian fiscal settings, interest-rate expectations and household spending ahead of elections.

n8fa1e95f28.headline: BSE Bonus Issue: BSE to conduct board meeting, consider bonus issue on THIS date | Stock Market News
n8fa1e95f28.summary: BSE will hold a board meeting on Sunday, March 30, 2025, to consider its upcoming bonus issue. The exchange announced the meeting date.
n8fa1e95f28.why: BSE is one of India's main stock exchanges, and bonus issues give existing shareholders additional shares without new capital.

ndfa2cef7de.headline: Wave Life Sciences Announces Positive Data from FORWARD-53 Clinical Trial in DMD Including Significant Functional Benefit and Reversal of Muscle Damage after 48 Weeks of Dosing with WVE-N531
ndfa2cef7de.summary: Wave Life Sciences reported statistically significant improvement of 3.8 seconds in Time-to-Rise versus natural history in the FORWARD-53 trial. The data cover WVE-N531 after 48 weeks of dosing in DMD.
ndfa2cef7de.why: Wave Life Sciences is a biotechnology company developing RNA-based medicines, and clinical trial results strongly influence its valuation.
ndfa2cef7de.why_moved: The company reported statistically significant and clinically meaningful improvement in the FORWARD-53 trial, which supports the drug's potential.

n1075f16ef1.headline: Inflation data green lights April rate cut
n1075f16ef1.summary: Australia's monthly CPI printed below expectations, with headline inflation at 2.4% against forecasts of 2.5%. Trimmed mean inflation fell to 2.7%, now within the Reserve Bank's target band.
n1075f16ef1.why: The Reserve Bank of Australia sets the cash rate, and inflation data shapes expectations for interest rate decisions that affect the economy and markets.
n1075f16ef1.why_moved: Headline and underlying inflation came in below expectations, strengthening the case for a rate cut at the April meeting.

ncf04cf0107.headline: Hyundai, Sendy develop AI-based logistics platform
ncf04cf0107.summary: South Korea's largest automaker Hyundai Motor has signed a memorandum of understanding with cargo logistics platform operator Sendy.ai. The two plan to develop an AI-based logistics platform.
ncf04cf0107.why: Hyundai is South Korea's largest carmaker, and logistics partnerships can reduce costs in its supply chain.

n830c692d7b.headline: CATL receives approval for Hong Kong listing
n830c692d7b.summary: Contemporary Amperex Technology (CATL) has secured approval from the China Securities Regulatory Commission for a share sale in Hong Kong. The approval is a required step before the listing.
n830c692d7b.why: CATL is the world's largest maker of electric vehicle batteries, and a Hong Kong listing gives it access to new capital and a second listing venue.

impacts.name: Contemporary Amperex Technology
impacts.why: Regulatory approval clears the way for a share sale in Hong Kong, which would raise capital for the company.

n2d78603c9b.headline: ECB's Digital Euro Sparks Flurry Of Online Misinformation
n2d78603c9b.summary: European Central Bank president Christine Lagarde's recent remarks on a digital euro prompted a fresh wave of online misinformation. The report says convincing the public of the project's merits will be an uphill battle.
n2d78603c9b.why: The digital euro is a planned central bank digital currency that would affect payments, banks and the monetary system in the euro area.

nf0aab93470.headline: The cuts and promises of the carbon tax and its impact on Canadians
nf0aab93470.summary: Prime Minister Mark Carney signed a directive to cut the consumer cost of carbon to zero from April 1, while upholding the industrial carbon tax. The shift came during a federal election campaign in which the Conservatives had promised to scrap the tax.
nf0aab93470.why: Carbon pricing affects energy costs for households and industry in Canada, shaping fuel demand and industrial investment decisions.

nb012253a82.headline: Sensex falls by 728 points, snaps 7-day gaining streak on profit-taking in IT, banking shares
nb012253a82.summary: The BSE Sensex declined 728.69 points, or 0.93%, to settle at 77,288.50, with 25 of its 30 components closing in the red, as profit-taking hit IT and banking shares.
nb012253a82.why: The BSE Sensex is the benchmark index of 30 large companies listed on the Bombay Stock Exchange, India's oldest exchange.

impacts.name: BSE Sensex
impacts.why: Profit-taking across most index components pushed the benchmark lower.

nb012253a82.why_moved: Profit-taking in IT and banking shares ended a seven-day gaining streak, with most index components closing lower.

nbd016228df.headline: Another retailer goes out of fashion, 600 jobs at risk
nbd016228df.summary: Retail chain Jeanswest has collapsed after more than five decades in business, threatening hundreds of jobs with more at risk.
nbd016228df.why: Jeanswest is an Australian apparel retailer, and collapses of mall-based chains signal pressure on domestic discretionary retail spending.

nfa128bfc6c.headline: Dollar Tree offloads Family Dollar chain for $1 billion, ending a decade-long effort to find a fit
nfa128bfc6c.summary: Dollar Tree is ending its decade-long effort to fold the Family Dollar chain into its business by selling it to a pair of private equity firms for $1 billion.
nfa128bfc6c.why: Dollar Tree is a US discount retailer. Divesting a struggling banner like Family Dollar is a portfolio decision that affects the retailer's store footprint and capital allocation.

n4f5ee2f372.headline: Trump announces 25% tariffs on foreign-made vehicles in bid to boost US  manufacturing
n4f5ee2f372.summary: President Donald Trump announced 25% tariffs on auto imports at a White House news conference on Wednesday, which the administration says will encourage domestic vehicle manufacturing.
n4f5ee2f372.why: Tariffs on auto imports raise costs for carmakers that build vehicles abroad and can reshape global automotive supply chains and trade flows.
n4f5ee2f372.why_moved: The announcement of 25% tariffs on foreign-made vehicles is a new trade measure that changes costs for automakers that import cars into the US.

n092f6cbf3a.headline: Trump announces new 25% tariff on imported cars and car parts
n092f6cbf3a.summary: President Trump announced a 25% tariff on imported cars and car parts, taking effect next week. He said the measure will boost US manufacturing.
n092f6cbf3a.why: Tariffs on imported vehicles and parts raise costs for automakers that rely on global supply chains and can reshape trade flows and pricing in the auto sector.
n092f6cbf3a.why_moved: The tariff is a new trade measure that raises the cost of imported cars and car parts, and the administration says it aims to boost US manufacturing.

n51a3a3eb98.headline: Mexico’s Auto Industry Climbs to Global Powerhouse—Can It Hold?
n51a3a3eb98.summary: Mexico became the world's fifth-largest light vehicle producer in 2024, overtaking Germany and South Korea, according to an analysis by The Rio Times.
n51a3a3eb98.why: Mexico's auto sector is a major manufacturing and export industry, closely linked to North American supply chains and US trade policy.

n8f78bdb10a.headline: Rising prices take centre stage in federal election as cost-of-living weighs on voters
n8f78bdb10a.summary: Inflation has eased from its peak in Canada, but rising rents, insurance and mortgage costs remain central voter concerns. The cost of living is expected to be a key issue in the April 28 federal election.
n8f78bdb10a.why: Household cost pressures shape interest-rate expectations and consumer spending, and election promises can affect fiscal policy.

nc31ed59d42.headline: Singapore, Vietnam sign five agreements across digital development, people ties, electricity trade
nc31ed59d42.summary: Singapore and Vietnam signed five agreements covering digital development, people ties and electricity trade during Prime Minister Lawrence Wong's two-day Hanoi visit.
nc31ed59d42.why: Electricity trade and digital cooperation between Southeast Asian economies affect regional energy supply and cross-border investment.

n1b17910d44.headline: Stock market today: Wall Street slumps as Nvidia, Tesla and other Big Tech stocks drop
n1b17910d44.summary: US stocks fell as shares of Nvidia, Tesla and other large technology companies dropped, pulling the broader market lower.
n1b17910d44.why: Nvidia designs AI chips and Tesla makes electric vehicles; both are heavily weighted in major US indexes, so their moves influence broad market performance.

impacts.why: Named among the Big Tech stocks that dropped.

n43a8c09003.headline: As Macron talks about building up Europe's defenses, Ukraine awaits actual results
n43a8c09003.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron hosts another Ukraine-focused summit in Paris on March 27, with questions open on whether Europe can keep Kyiv afloat.
n43a8c09003.why: European defence spending and support for Ukraine shape government budgets, defence industry orders and the region's economic and security outlook.

n59b5c54a2d.headline: Pakistan Business Council opposes hasty reduction in customs duty
n59b5c54a2d.summary: The Pakistan Business Council opposes a hasty reduction in customs duty and seeks a detailed plan to cut costs and remove key obstacles.
n59b5c54a2d.why: Customs duties affect import costs, domestic industry protection and government revenue, all of which matter to businesses and investors.

n16a5ca02c1.headline: Vietnam proposes to cut tariffs on LNG, cars, agricultural goods
n16a5ca02c1.summary: Vietnam's finance ministry has proposed cutting preferential import tariffs on products including LNG, cars, wood and agricultural goods. The move aims to avoid the imminent threat of US tariffs.
n16a5ca02c1.why: Tariff changes alter the cost of imports and trade flows between Vietnam, the US and other partners, affecting energy buyers, automakers and agricultural exporters.

nf19282df93.headline: Vacation home market slows after pandemic boom, but prices still rising: Royal LePage
nf19282df93.summary: Royal LePage reports fewer Canadians are buying vacation homes in some regions, but expects prices to rise in 2025 as demand still outpaces supply.
nf19282df93.why: Royal LePage is a major Canadian real estate brokerage whose reports track residential property trends that affect mortgage lending and household wealth.
